sections.title: Our Craft & Community
sections.subtitle: We focus on the details so you can focus on the moment.

items.title: Single-Origin Espresso
items.text: Ethically sourced beans, roasted light to highlight their natural sweetness and complex tasting notes.

items.title: House-made Pastries
items.text: Flaky croissants and seasonal fruit galettes baked fresh every morning by our resident pastry chef.

items.title: Community Canvas
items.text: A welcoming environment designed for deep conversations, quiet reading, or serendipitous local encounters.

items.title: Expert Baristas
items.text: Our team is intensely passionate about coffee science, ensuring every extraction and pour is flawless.

items.quote: Best coffee in the Mission. The baristas know their craft and are genuinely passionate about it. Every pour is consistently excellent.
items.author: Casey P.

items.quote: Love the atmosphere. Great place to work, meet friends, or just enjoy an impeccably balanced cortado. It really feels like a neighborhood living room.
items.author: Jordan K.

items.quote: Their seasonal single-origins are always dialed in perfectly. Exploring their new roasts has become my favorite weekend morning ritual.
items.author: Alex M.

items.question: Do you offer vegan milk alternatives?
items.answer: Yes, we proudly serve oat milk and a house-made macadamia-cashew blend at no extra charge.

items.question: Is there Wi-Fi available?
items.answer: We have fast, free Wi-Fi available on weekdays. On weekends, we turn it off to encourage unplugged community connection and relaxation.

items.question: Can I buy your coffee beans to brew at home?
items.answer: Absolutely. We retail bags of our seasonal single-origins and our signature espresso blend, freshly roasted each Tuesday.

items.question: Do you host private events or pop-ups?
items.answer: We do rent our space for intimate evening gatherings and frequently host local food pop-ups. Reach out to our team for availability.

sections.title: Join Us for Your Morning Ritual
sections.subtitle: Whether you need a quick shot of espresso before work or a quiet spot to read for hours, our doors are open.

sections.title: Drop Us a Line
sections.subtitle: Have a question about our roasts, pastry pre-orders, or private events? We'd love to hear from you.
